source_selection: Anycubic Color Type / Hex Code tables for PLA Basic, PLA+ and PETG
Polymaker own HueForge wiki enumerating HEX for the exact PolyLite PLA/Panchroma Matte/PolyLite PLA Pro shade
limitations: Do not convert Clear/no-code shades to generic white or alpha; only numerical manufacturer swatches were imported.

Anycubic PLA+ storefront locales show some inconsistent HEX (notably White); this snapshot uses a single global-store Color Type table for the whole line. Region-specific variation is a future reconciliation task.
Polymaker HueForge pack color codes document a finite selected subset, not the complete product palette.
Neither manufacturer's display HEX is a calibrated colorimetry measurement of printed parts.
